title: A Uniform for the Harbor
author: Zephyrine Zhou
blurb: Oscar Eriksen, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
